ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40-45% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels (normalized intensity > 0.8) concentrated in distal regions, contrasted against low-intensity dark pixels (normalized intensity < 0.2) in the central and leading edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes. The left lobe contains a dense, irregular field of dark-pixel mottling. The right lobe shows more fragmented white regions bisected by dark linear features. The central region near the peduncle is a solid low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 62 degrees and a depth of approximately 18% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys ranging 5-15 pixels in depth) along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe distal edge exhibits more pronounced, irregular jaggedness compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a convex sweep from the peduncle to the tips. Trailing edges are generally concave as they approach the median notch and transition to complex irregular curves distally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (rosettes) are clearly visible at the extreme tips of both lobes and along the high-amplitude serrations of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, including one prominent horizontal mark in the upper distal quadrant and several shorter, unaligned diagonal marks near the mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular indentations and jagged tissue loss along the distal trailing edges of both lobes, particularly a prominent notch-like void on the far right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, high-contrast 'peppered' mottling pattern within the white fields of the left lobe.
